thread:
Laura G.: hey team — opened a docs PR updating the audit-log CLI export example and SOC2-friendly retention wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4122. can someone glance for accuracy and any legal/copy concerns?

Samir Patel: thanks — quick skim: the CLI example uses `--since 0` in the snippet but the real CLI expects RFC3339 timestamps. that's going to confuse users.

Laura G.: good catch. i pulled that from the old md. i can swap to an RFC3339 example. any other pitfalls?

Priya K.: also note that the CLI output shown as "jsonl" in the docs is actually gz-compressed by default on our backend when exporting >100MB. we should mention `--no-compress` or explain the .gz suffix. small note but saves support tickets.

Rohan V.: to add: retention TTL language — docs say "retained for 90 days by default" but the backend TTL is configurable per-tenant and defaults to 180 for trial accounts. we need to avoid a hard number in the main page and instead show the default for hosted vs dedicated. maybe a table?

Maya (Legal): wording: for SOC2 we should avoid saying "we keep logs for X days" as an absolute. recommend phrasing: "Logs are retained per customer configuration; default retention policies are described below. Customers may request longer retention via contract." keeps it accurate and audit-friendly.

Laura G.: ok i'll update to Maya's phrasing. for CLI snippet i will add an explicit example showing RFC3339 and compressed output. draft below — feedback?

Docs Bot: automated check — found a broken internal link in the PR to /legal/retention-policy (404). please verify.

Samir Patel: LGTM on Maya's phrasing. for code example, show both a minimal and a telemetry-safe version (redacted fields). maybe include a curl + jq line to preview without saving big files.

Laura G.: proposed snippet: ```
redwood export audit-logs --since "2024-02-01T00:00:00Z" \\   --until "2024-02-07T00:00:00Z" \\   --format jsonl.gz \\   --tenant-id abc123 \
# preview first 10 lines without writing full file
redwood export audit-logs --since "2024-02-01T00:00:00Z" --until "2024-02-07T00:00:00Z" --format jsonl.gz --tenant-id abc123 | zcat | jq -c '.[0:10]'
```
(plus note explaining `--no-compress` and that `--tenant-id` is required for Dedicated)

Priya K.: that looks good. add a redaction reminder: "Do not include PII in exported logs; use `--redact` to mask user fields if needed." and show a one-line example.

Laura G.: added `--redact user.email,user.ip` example. will also fix the internal link that Docs Bot flagged. i'll push an update in ~30m. thanks all :thumbsup:

Rohan V.: can ops/eng confirm the trial/default TTL numbers before merge? tagging @samir for the authoritative source.

Samir Patel: confirmed — hosted default is 90, trial/test accounts default 180, dedicated follows contract. i'll leave a short note in the PR and link to the config table in infra.

Maya (Legal): thanks — once copy updated i'll +1 from legal for SOC2 phrasing.

Laura G.: thanks everyone, updating now.

Docs Bot: PR CI passed (link-checks fixed).
